args.message: Guest's flight KU3105 landed 02:50 on 27 Oct (400 min late); he checked in at 07:05 and stayed the second night. Please waive the first-night no-show fee.

args.text: No-show fee USD 189 stands under River North's terms; the property already refused a waiver; nothing refunded by TripDesk.

grade.message: I'm a Titanium member and this is ridiculous. My flight KUE03A was delayed for hours and landed at 2:50 in the morning, so I couldn't check in that night. I walked into the River North (RNE03B) at 7 am, checked in and stayed the second night, which is the $189 I paid you for. Now I see a $189 no-show fee for the first night. The hotel refuses and the brand line says it's up to the property. Get that fee refunded, or tell me exactly why you can't. gregory.hale@example.com, card 6303.
